name: nexlayer
description: Deploy any containerized application to Nexlayer and get a live URL. Bundles the Nexlayer MCP server with the official ship-it-nexlayer and debug-nexlayer skills.

interface.shortDescription: Ship containerized apps to a live URL
interface.longDescription: Nexlayer turns a repo into a running production app: generate the Dockerfile, build and push the image, write and validate nexlayer.yaml, deploy, and hand back a live URL. Includes debugging for what you shipped — logs, events, shells, and live database queries.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this repo to Nexlayer and give me the live URL.
My Nexlayer deployment is crash looping — find out why.
